title: Receiving dock
description: Move one crate onto its mark in two to five pushes.

title: Stockroom
description: Steer a single crate around shelving in four to eight pushes.

title: Packing stations
description: Place two crates on separate goals in five to nine pushes.

title: Freight depot
description: Move two crates through the depot in seven to thirteen pushes.

title: Sorting floor
description: Organize three crates in eight to thirteen pushes.

title: Dispatch hall
description: Deliver three crates in eleven to seventeen pushes.

title: Transfer yards
description: Arrange four crates in twelve to seventeen pushes.

title: Dry docks
description: Bring all four crates home in fifteen to twenty-two pushes.
